<script type='text/javascript'>
$(document).ready(function() {
	{{if $slider->ticker && $slider->style != 'vertical'}}
		$('#Fcontent_{$slider->id} .fcTicker').css({
			"max-width": $("#sliderWrapper_{$slider->id}").innerWidth(),
			"max-height": {$slider->tickerHeight},
			"overflow-y": "hidden",
		});
		
		$('#Fcontent_{$slider->id} .fcTicker').carouselTicker({
			speed: {expression="$slider->speed/1000"},
			reverse: false,
			direction: "prev",
		});
		
		{{if $slider->nolink != 1}}
			$( "#Fcontent_{$slider->id} .fcTicker a" ).on('click touchstart', function () {
				window.open( $(this).attr('href'), {{if $slider->viewlinkin == 'page'}}'_blank'{{else}}'_self'{{endif}} ); 
				return false;
			});
		{{endif}} 
		setTimeout(function(){
			$("#sliderWrapper_{$slider->id}").css({
				"opacity": 1,
				"height": "auto"
			});
		}, 300 );
	{{else}}
		$('.slider_{$slider->id}').bxSlider({
			wrapperClass: 'fcWrapper',
			mode: '{$slider->style}',
			slideMargin: {$slider->margin},
			minSlides: {{if $slider->style == 'vertical'}}{$slider->maxSlides}{{else}}{$slider->minSlides}{{endif}},
			maxSlides: {$slider->maxSlides},
			{{if $slider->img_w > 0}}
				slideWidth: {$slider->img_w},			
			{{endif}}
			slideHeight: {$slider->img_h},
			adaptiveHeight: true,
			auto: {{if $slider->autoplay == 1}}true{{else}}false{{endif}},
			autoDirection: 'next',
			autoControls: {{if $slider->autocontrol == 1}}true{{else}}false{{endif}},
			autoControlsCombine: false,			
			controls: {{if $slider->shownav == 1}}true{{else}}false{{endif}},
			keyboardEnabled: {{if $slider->keyboard == 1}}true{{else}}false{{endif}},	
			autoHover: true,
			speed: {$slider->speed},
			ticker: {{if $slider->ticker == 1}}true{{else}}false{{endif}},	
			tickerHover: true,
			pause: {$slider->duration},
			useCSS: false,
			touchEnabled: false,
			{{if $slider->easing && $slider->easing != 'none'}}easing: '{$slider->easing}',{{endif}}	
			pager: {{if $slider->showpage == 1}}true{{else}}false{{endif}},
			onSliderLoad: function(){
				setTimeout(function(){
					$("#sliderWrapper_{$slider->id}").css({
						"opacity": 1,
						"height": "auto"
					});
				}, 300 );
			},

		});
	{{endif}}
});
</script>
